reply.text: {"say":"The bike opener isn't available to you, so I opened with chest pressing, an incline then a flat press, followed by a fly, and finished with two triceps movements.","title":"Chest & Triceps","days":[{"name":"Chest & Triceps","exercises":[{"key":"barbell-bench-press","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Shoulder blades pinched, control the descent"},{"key":"dumbbell-incline-bench-press","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"30-degree incline"},{"key":"cable-chest-fly","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Slight elbow bend, squeeze at the middle"},{"key":"parallel-bar-dip","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Lean forward slightly"},{"key":"cable-triceps-pushdown","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Elbows pinned to your sides"},{"key":"cable-overhead-triceps-extension","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Keep elbows pointing forward"}]}],"unmet":["I couldn't add the five minutes on the bike because bike cardio isn't something you can do here, so the session starts with chest."]}
